data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The non-expert panel plus checklist is more reliable than the solo expert only when the checklist is the codification of domain expertise; its reliability is not its own, it is borrowed expertise given high-fidelity execution by the panel.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the task requires non-propositional expertise that the checklist cannot codify, the expert retains an advantage.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the checklist is not derived from domain expertise but from surface heuristics, any reliability gain is mere compliance tracking the right answer.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the panel members share a systematic bias not present in the expert, aggregation cannot correct it.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the task distribution shifts such that the checklist's codified expertise becomes stale, the expert's adaptive intuition regains an advantage.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Domain expertise exists as non-propositional skill refined over years. When this expertise is codified into a checklist, it is externalized into propositional form. The trained non-expert panel applies this propositional expertise with high fidelity because they have no competing non-propositional intuitions. The mechanism of reliability gain is: (1) expert knowledge is transferred from a single expert (high bandwidth, low fidelity \u2014 embodied intuition) to a panel (low bandwidth, high fidelity \u2014 checklist execution), and (2) the panel's aggregate judgment suppresses individual execution errors via majority vote or consensus. Reliability gain is genuine only when the checklist's propositions causally determine the correct answer through the panel's collective reasoning, not when the checklist merely correlates with the answer via surface features the panel learns to pattern-match.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
